text:
maria: Lunch challenge idea — weighted vest sprint vs pull-up showdown on the roof at 12:30? winner gets coffee bragging rights and a spot on the 'hall of flex' whiteboard :coffee: :muscle:
aj: Oooft yes. What's the format? short sprint + max pullups?
sam: I'm down but only if we keep it beginner-friendly. no one-sprint-to-injury pls 😅
kai: I can bring a 20lb vest and sled harness if we want optional sled for the sprints. also I'll be the official stopwatch nerd.
maria: Proposed micro-format:
```
12:30 - quick warmup (5 min)
12:35 - Vest sprints: 3 x 60m with 60s rest (optional sled lane)
12:50 - 2-min AMRAP pull-ups (scale: assisted band or negatives)
13:00 - podium + photos
```
jen: Love the scaling note. I'll bring a band for assisted pullups and a towel.
aj: Can we do a lightweight scoreboard? I'll jot names + reps. winner = highest normalized score (sprints normalized by time, pullups by reps). math by aj 😈
sam: Be careful on the roof if it's wet — backup plan: courtyard or garage.
maria: Good call. If rain, move to garage. kai — you cool with setting up cones/markers?
kai: Yep. I'll mark sprint lane and flag the no-sled lane for anyone who wants plain vest.
jen: Also, is this okay for people with shoulder issues? I'm tagging scale: do a 1-min plank hold as alternative or ring rows.
fit-bot: Reminder: please complete the short waiver before participating — https://forms.gle/wxExample (sports waiver, 1 question).
aj: sign-up sheet: `maria / aj / sam / kai / jen` — reply to add yourself.
maria: Cool — looks like a full crew. Anyone streaming for posterity? (i promise not to post without consent)
sam: I'll take a goofy slow-mo replay if we win. :camera_with_flash: 
jen: Count me in. Also, winner owes losers a round of iced coffee. standard. :coffee::sweat_smile:
aj: Trade: if I beat you all in pullups I get to rename the whiteboard entry for a week. deal? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
maria: Deal. Low stakes, high vibes. See y'all 12:30.
fit-bot: Weather check at 12:05 and final go/no-go posted to this thread. Good luck! :four_leaf_clover:
